Class ClientNetworkDispatcher

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am02.client.network.ClientNetworkDispatcher
All Implemented Interfaces:
VirtualView
public class ClientNetworkDispatcher extends Object implements VirtualView
Unified entry point for all inbound server notifications on the client side.

Implements VirtualView so that it can be used both as the target of direct RMI calls (via RmiServerProxy) and as the argument of Event#apply(VirtualView) (Socket path). In both cases every notifyXxx call ends up here and is forwarded to either LobbyModel or the GameModel owned by the ClientController, depending on the current game phase.

The dispatcher also tracks activeNickname and activeGameId to support lazy GameModel creation (ensureGameModel()) and session restoration after reconnection.

    • notifyError

      public void notifyError(String message)
      Sends an error message to this client only (not stored in global history).

      If no GameModel is active, the error is forwarded to the LobbyModel instead and activeGameId is cleared to prevent stale rejoin attempts.

      Specified by:
      notifyError in interface VirtualView
      Parameters:
      message - the human-readable error description
